title: Every World Cup Final
description: The biggest game in football. How many World Cup finals can you call?

questions.q: Who beat France on penalties in the 2022 final?
questions.explain: Argentina won 4–2 on penalties after a 3–3 draw in Qatar.

questions.q: France beat which team 4–2 in the 2018 final?
Who scored the extra-time winner in the 2014 final for Germany?
questions.explain: Götze volleyed home to beat Argentina 1–0.

questions.q: Whose goal won Spain the 2010 final against the Netherlands?
questions.explain: Iniesta scored in extra time for a 1–0 win.

questions.q: Which match ended with Zidane's headbutt on Marco Materazzi?
questions.explain: Italy beat France on penalties in the 2006 final.

questions.q: Who scored twice as Brazil beat Germany 2–0 in the 2002 final?
questions.explain: Ronaldo's two goals sealed Brazil's fifth title.

questions.q: Who scored twice in France's 3–0 win over Brazil in the 1998 final?
questions.explain: Zidane headed in two; Petit added the third.

questions.q: Who missed the decisive penalty as Brazil beat Italy in the 1994 final?
questions.explain: Baggio skied his penalty; Brazil won the first final decided on spot-kicks.
